project.name: Text to CAE CalculiX Cantilever Modal
project.prompt: Extract the natural frequencies and the first bending mode shape of a clamped steel cantilever bar using the open-source CalculiX solver.

connection.message: CalculiX solved the 5-mode *FREQUENCY step; the .dat eigenvalue table and mode-1 eigenvector were exported to result_mesh.json.

value.en: 120 mm long square bar, 8 x 8 mm cross-section
value.zh: 120 mm 长方钢梁，截面 8 x 8 mm

value.en: Steel, E = 210000 MPa, nu = 0.3, rho = 7.85e-9 t/mm^3
Root face clamped (ENCASTRE); free vibration, no load, 5 eigenpairs
value.zh: 根部端面固支（ENCASTRE）；自由振动无载荷，5 阶模态

value.en: C3D8 hexahedral solid elements, 24 x 4 x 4 (384 elements)
value.zh: C3D8 六面体单元，24 x 4 x 4（384 个单元）

outputs.rendered_field: Mode 1 eigenvector normalized to max |U| = 1 (colour = |U| magnitude, display scale 18x) - stress-free displacement shape

workflow.detail: Map the request to a clamped steel square bar with a free-vibration *FREQUENCY step (5 eigenpairs).
Generate cantilever_modal.inp (same mesh as the static case; *FREQUENCY 5 with *NODE PRINT U so eigenvectors reach the .dat).
Run ccx -i cantilever_modal; a *FREQUENCY step writes a header-only .sta (no increments), so success also accepts a non-empty .dat.
Parse the E I G E N V A L U E O U T P U T table (mode, eigenvalue, rad/s, cycles/s); stop before the participation-factor table.
Parse the per-mode eigenvector blocks (E I G E N V A L U E N U M B E R N) and merge mode 1 with the .inp topology into result_mesh.json for the viewer.
